content.text: After a Homes search reaches results without dates, the results header accepts newly added valid Check-in and Check-out dates directly on the results page.

expected_answer.operand: results-header Check-in and Check-out controls accept newly added valid dates after a no-dates search

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] Applied user-reach and change-frequency: results-page search refinement is central to guest search for Homes and the header/routing behavior is likely to change with search UX iterations; money, auth, and data-loss do not apply.

[risk_factors] Applied user-reach and change-frequency: direct header editability affects all guests refining a search and is likely to evolve with search-surface changes; money, auth, and data-loss do not apply.

[risk_factors] Applied user-reach and change-frequency: visible active query parameters affect broad guest comprehension and frequently shift with header presentation updates; money, auth, and data-loss do not apply.

[risk_factors] Applied user-reach and change-frequency: the no-dates add-dates path affects guests who postpone date selection and is sensitive to ongoing search-header UX changes; money, auth, and data-loss do not apply.
[applicability] Applicable because the scenario concludes with a results-header edit and refreshed results without homepage navigation.
[applicability] Applicable because the scenario's edit_target parameter enumerates destination, dates, and guests, covering the full universal editability promise.
[applicability] Applicable because the scenario observes the active query in the results header before and after the in-place edit.
[applicability] Applicable because adding dates later from the results header is still a parameter edit whose outcome is refreshed results in place.

[applicability] Not applicable because this scenario proves date entry after a no-dates start, but it does not prove the broader forall promise that destination, dates, and guests are each directly editable in this journey.
[applicability] Applicable because after dates are added, the active query parameters for the current results are shown in the header.
